content:
There

[Verse 1]
[Cm]once was a ship that put to sea And the
[Fm]name of the ship was the [Cm]Billy o' Tea The
[Cm]winds blew up, her bow dipped down
[Cm]Blow, my [G]bully boys, [Cm]blow Ha!

[Chorus]
[Ab]Soon may the [Eb]Wellerman come To
[Fm]bring us sugar and [Cm]tea and rum
[Ab]One day, when the [Eb]tonguin' is done We'll
[Ab]take our [G]leave and [Cm]go She

[Verse 2]
[Cm]had not been two weeks from shore When
[Fm]down on her a [Cm]right whale bore The
[Cm]captain called all hands and swore He'd
[Cm]take that [G]whale in [Cm]tow Ha!

[Chorus]
[Ab]Soon may the [Eb]Wellerman come To
[Fm]bring us sugar and [Cm]tea and rum
[Ab]One day, when the [Eb]tonguin' is done We'll
[Ab]take our [G]leave and [Cm]go Be-

[Verse 3]
[Cm]fore the boat had hit the water The
[Fm]whale's tail came [Cm]up and caught her All
[Cm]hands to the side, harpooned and fought her When
[Cm]she dived [G]down [Cm]below Ha!

[Chorus]
[Ab]Soon may the [Eb]Wellerman come To
[Fm]bring us sugar and [Cm]tea and rum
[Ab]One day, when the [Eb]tonguin' is done We'll
[Ab]take our [G]leave and [Cm]go No

[Verse 4]
[Cm]line was cut, no whale was freed The
[Fm]Captain's mind was [Cm]not of greed But
[Cm]he belonged to the whaleman's creed She
[Cm]took the [G]ship in [Cm]tow Ha!

[Chorus]
[Ab]Soon may the [Eb]Wellerman come To
[Fm]bring us sugar and [Cm]tea and rum
[Ab]One day, when the [Eb]tonguin' is done We'll
[Ab]take our [G]leave and [Cm]go For

[Verse 5]
[Cm]forty days, or even more The
[Fm]line went slack, then [Cm]tight once more All
[Cm]boats were lost, there were only four But
[Cm]still that [G]whale did [Cm]go

[Chorus]
[Ab]Soon may the [Eb]Wellerman come To
[Fm]bring us sugar and [Cm]tea and rum
[Ab]One day, when the [Eb]tonguin' is done We'll
[Ab]take our [G]leave and [Cm]go As

[Verse 6]
[Cm]far as I've heard, the fight's still on The
[Fm]line's not cut and the [Cm]whale's not gone The
[Cm]Wellerman makes his regular call To en-
[Fm]courage the Captain, [Cm]crew, and all

[Chorus]
[Ab]Soon may the [Eb]Wellerman come To
[Fm]bring us sugar and [Cm]tea and rum
[Ab]One day, when the [Eb]tonguin' is done We'll
[Ab]take our [G]leave and [Cm]go [Eb]
[Ab]Soon may the [Eb]Wellerman come To
[Fm]bring us sugar and [Cm]tea and rum
[Ab]One day, when the [Eb]tonguin' is done We'll
[Ab]take our [G]leave and [Cm]go
